mapper.select: select id, username, password_hash, nickname, role, admin_approved, banned, auth_version, created_at, updated_at, deleted from pw_user where lower(username) = lower(#{username}) and deleted = 0 limit 1
select id, username, password_hash, nickname, role, admin_approved, banned, auth_version, created_at, updated_at, deleted from pw_user where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 limit 1
SELECT id, username, password_hash, nickname, role, banned, admin_approved, auth_version, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pw_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.role, u.banned, u.admin_approved FROM pw_user u WHERE u.deleted=0 AND (#{query}='' OR u.username ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR u.nickname ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) ORDER BY u.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM pw_user WHERE role='ADMIN' AND admin_approved=1 AND deleted=0 AND banned=0 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pw_user SET role = #{role}, admin_approved = CASE WHEN #{role} = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, admin_approved_at = CASE WHEN #{role} = 'ADMIN' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, admin_approval_source = CASE WHEN #{role} = 'ADMIN' THEN 'ADMIN_UI' ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{userId} AND deleted=0
